posts.en:
dsh-settings-nav-fold is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Fold plugin/extension settings entries in the DSH settings panel into one collapsible "Plugin entries" group row — one click to expand or collapse, auto-updating as plugins come and go.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7e1cdff3a05a372906b6.html
